the_letter.name: A Letter from Julie
the_letter.description:
The letter looked a hundred years old. Auntie Julie, a woman you were told you had and never met, asked you to Castle for your birthday. Twelve hours on the Sunday train. No signal since the tunnel.

The map in the letter is one road from Castle Halt. It ends at a house and a dog.
the_letter.completion: The stoop is real. Julie is not on it. The dog has been waiting.

requirements.text: Auntie Julie's house, at the end of the station road

defeat_skeleton.name: The Thing in the Yard
defeat_skeleton.description: The dog wants the walking bones off Julie's fence line. It will not say why a key is waiting until they stay down.
defeat_skeleton.completion: The skeleton will not get up again today. The dog has decided you are allowed a key.
defeat_skeleton.returnTo: the dog, on Julie's step, by day

requirements.text: The bones walking Julie's fence line

see_the_kitchen.name: Julie's Kitchen
see_the_kitchen.description: The house key was always for you. Go in. Look at what she left out.
see_the_kitchen.completion: Auntie is not home. The house still is.

requirements.text: Stand in Julie's kitchen

stock_the_bench.name: Dust, Water, Pansy
stock_the_bench.description: Julie's note says the bench is set for one potion and that you should make it before you go down any stairs. Gold dust, a vial of water, a pansy from the pantry chest. Stand at the bench and open your bags. The dog will want to know.
stock_the_bench.completion: It fizzes blue. You made that. The dog is not surprised.
stock_the_bench.returnTo: the dog, on Julie's step, by day

requirements.text: A Manashield potion, made at the bench in Julie's kitchen

rats_below.name: Under the House
rats_below.description: There are rats in the cellar under Julie's kitchen, down either hatch. The dog wants three pieces of meat and will not say what for.
rats_below.completion: Three pieces, wrapped in a page of the parish news. The dog did not want them. It wants you to keep them.
rats_below.returnTo: the dog, on Julie's step, by day

requirements.text: Rat meat, from the rats in Julie's cellar

the_mine.name: The Gold Mine
the_mine.description: The Gold Mine is at the end of the mine road out of Castle; its mouth is the one with the lamp. The Headmaster keeps the vault key. Something called Iron Knuckles keeps everything else. Broken things down there want Repair, and Repair wants wood and iron.
the_mine.completion: The mine is quiet. Goldskin dug it, and the dead went on digging after him. They have stopped. The vault held a brass key tagged MAGIC.
the_mine.returnTo: the dog, on Julie's step, by day

requirements.text: The Gold Mine, at the end of the mine road
The Headmaster, down the gold mine
Iron Knuckles, down the gold mine

the_museum.name: The Museum
the_museum.description: The Museum is across the river from Castle, on the road over the bridge, and the brass key from the mine's vault opens its front door. Open until nine. One wing has had its name painted over. The dog wants you to see what was kept in it.
the_museum.completion: You went into the wing that was painted over. The case that was not on the plan held a council key on a green tag.
the_museum.returnTo: the dog, on Julie's step, by day

requirements.text: The Museum, across the river from Castle
The Attendant, in the painted-over wing of the Museum

the_forest.name: Butterfly Forest
the_forest.description: The key on the green tag opens the gate of Butterfly Forest, on the road past the ruined library. The dog says to read the library's last page before the gate: nothing in that forest grows for anyone who has not. The forest is open from sunrise to sunset, and visitors are counted in and out.
the_forest.completion: Eleven glass cases on the Collector's wall, labelled with trades and not species. You were counted in, and you were counted out.
the_forest.returnTo: the dog, on Julie's step, by day

requirements.text: The ruined library, on the road past the Museum
The gate of Butterfly Forest, past the ruined library
The Emperor, at the stone in Butterfly Forest

the_factory.name: The Factory
the_factory.description: The Factory is the Company's, in the Works past the graveyard. The pipes under Castle run there, dry most days, from a grate at the edge of the town. The Company kept a key in the Factory to one door of its own, and the dog wants it.
the_factory.completion: The Foreman is down and the roller door is open onto the yard. His locker held a key stamped G.M.Co., tagged for the stone on the graveyard footpath.
the_factory.returnTo: the dog, on Julie's step, by day

requirements.text: The pipes, down the grate at the edge of Castle
The Factory, in the Works
The Foreman, in the Factory's assembly hall

the_burial.name: Under the Stone
the_burial.description: The Burial Chamber is past Castle, off the graveyard road: a footpath from the graveyard ends at a standing stone that says DO NOT, and the Company's key unlocks the stair under it. Cold, dark, foggy. The torches wake for cold. Feed the small snakes; do not fight them. What is buried there was buried with a ball of gold, and the dog wants it brought up.
the_burial.completion: The Ball was in his box, at the foot of a stair that goes up and not out. It is heavier than it looks.
the_burial.returnTo: the dog, on Julie's step, by day

requirements.text: The standing stone, on the footpath from the graveyard
The garden, inside the Burial Chamber
The Ball, in the Burial Chamber

the_school.name: The School
the_school.description: The School is on the hill north of Castle: the one lit window. The stair out of the Burial Chamber comes up in its boiler room, and the key on the caretaker's bin opens the front doors from outside. The bell is rung from the tower. The dog wants to know who rings it.
the_school.completion: You went up the tower. The register in the top room is marked up to this morning, and the last name in it is yours.
the_school.returnTo: the dog, on Julie's step, by day

requirements.text: The School, on the hill north of Castle
Whoever rings the bell, in the School's tower
